info.title: API.SH: MyAnimeList
info.description: The MyAnimeList API from API.SH: public MyAnimeList data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search anime or manga with every filter of the site's advanced search: media type, status, minimum score, age rating, producer or magazine, start and end dates, genres to include and exclude, first letter, sort and order. Each result: id, title, link, image, type, episodes or chapters and volumes, score, members, start and end dates, rating and a synopsis snippet. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/myanimelist-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Title words (3+ characters; optional when a filter is given).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: anime (default) or manga.

parameters.name: media_type
parameters.description: Anime: tv, ova, movie, special, ona, music, cm, pv, tv_special. Manga: manga, light_novel, one_shot, doujinshi, manhwa, manhua, novel.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Anime: airing, finished, upcoming. Manga: publishing, finished, upcoming, hiatus, discontinued.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: Minimum score 1-10.

parameters.name: rated
parameters.description: Anime age rating: g, pg, pg13, r, r_plus, rx.

parameters.name: producer
parameters.description: Anime producer or studio id or link (e.g. 11 for Madhouse).

parameters.name: magazine
parameters.description: Manga magazine id or link.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Started on or after: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Ended on or before: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genre ids or names that must match, e.g. Action,Fantasy.

parameters.name: exclude_genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated genre ids or names to leave out.

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: First letter A-Z, or . for digits and symbols.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: title, start_date, end_date, score, members, type, episodes, rated (anime), volumes, chapters (manga).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: desc (default) or asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (50 per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
